## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest useful change that solves it.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] `pytest` passes.
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented.
- [ ] External data sources include provenance and licensing/terms notes.
- [ ] No credentials, proprietary datasets, private trading strategies, or order-execution logic are included.

## Data-source notes

If this pull request integrates a market-data source, describe the authoritative source, update behavior, caching/reproducibility approach, and expected failure modes.
